name: io.github.Servosity/superops-mcp
title: SuperOps MCP
description: Every SuperOps PSA+RMM entity in your terminal, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the SUPEROPS_API_TOKEN credential for the SuperOps MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the SuperOps API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Data-centre region your tenant lives in: us or eu. The wrong region answers with an authentication error.

environmentVariables.name: SUPEROPS_SUBDOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Your tenant subdomain (SuperOps: Settings > MSP Information). Sent as the CustomerSubdomain header on every call; requests without it are rejected.
